status: authored 2026-10-09 as a walk-through hall (docs/world-building/GYM_WALKTHROUGH.md); offline checks only (tools/gym_arenas.py check, tools/gym_arenas_audit.py, tools/gym_trainers.py check). Nothing of it has been built in a world or seen in a running game.
name: The Assay House and the Core Gallery
reading: Blaine's town studies the crater's energy (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym7_town: core-sample racks, a field laboratory, survey tables, a fumarole vent; blackstone, basalt, tuff, copper). One house on the rim at the causeway's end, walked through: in at the west door onto the drill floor, up the spoil steps over the wall, along the deck and across the broken flight, down one of four copper-hooded stairs (three stop on straw; the lit one goes on) to the flue's foot, then north onto the Core Gallery's upper floor and down its broad stair into the core -- the drilled section of the cone in bands (deepslate, blackstone, a thin calcite ash bed, basalt flows, tuff, a second ash bed, a basalt cap) in the walls and in glass core tubes, magma held behind glass in the north wall, and at the far end the assayer's stage with the bore-hole behind it: a seven-by-seven window of lava sealed in the wall behind glass, a sill of magma under it, copper pylons either side. Blaine stands on the stage, three over the floor. Out by the iron door at the stair's head, or back the way you came.

leader.seat_why: in the stage top at y106 (floor y103 + 3, the house's own level), z4987: two north of the gallery's axis (z4989, where the Pokemon blocks and survey lines are) so that the Challenge cell (6159, 106, 4982), the only dais cell outside the old Assay House's bounds (z4983 and up are inside them), is five from it: tests/test_challenge_mode.py holds a Challenge cell to 2..5 from the seat, and tools/gym_arenas_audit.py (assemble) calls a cell inside the old bounds an old seat still standing. The bore-hole is centred on the seat. THE ONE SOURCE of Blaine's seat (tools/gym_arenas.py leader_seats).

through_building.why: the adit's first leg, where it leaves the assay vault: the vault's floor is cut for the first four steps (x6179, z5001..5004, y106) and its head room opens y107..109 over them; below, the stair is cut under the vault's south wall footing. Inside the building's bounds (x6156..6182, z4983..5007, y103 and up); the vault's walls above y106 and the geyser's casing (z4996..4998) are never touched.

battle.why: Cobblemon Battle Positions (docs/world-building/GYM_ARENAS.md): both Pokemon blocks sit one under the floor's top course (y83 under y84), so spawnHeightOffset 2.0 stands each Pokemon on the floor; the trainer stand is under the stage top one in front of the seat, so Blaine steps to the stage edge. Blaine's Pokemon block is 5.5 from the stage face (z4985.0 to the block's centre 4990.5) against Charizard's sweep of 4.09; the two Pokemon are 6 apart (Magmortar's hitbox is 1.53 wide), the challenger's 11 from the foot of the stage, well inside Battle Positions' 16; the challenger stands 3 behind their own, as the donor gyms set it.

arena.clipped_why: as built, bounds [6154, 81, 4976, 6181, 103, 5014] and the adit box [6178, 101, 5001, 6180, 109, 5007]; both are clipped here to y102 because the old building's own footing course y103 (data/gym_buildings/gym7.json bounds start at y103) overlaps the arena's top row, and tools/gym_arenas.py hall_checks counts a cell the takedown set to rock as 'never written by the hall' even though the hall rewrites it. The hall's footing fill rewrites every y103..105 cell of the lot itself; the only y103 cells outside the lot are the adit's blackstone walls at z5011..5013, buried under three courses of natural stone.

replaces.why: what stood before this hall and is taken down by it, measured from the records that built it, never guessed. The arena is data/gym_arenas/gym7.json as it was built and applied to staging on 2026-10-09 (schema gym_arena/1, git history: the Core Gallery carved at y81..103 under the lot, its adit leaving the vault); the building is data/gym_buildings/gym7.json, kept, now superseded_by this file. Below the lot the takedown function (gym7_takedown) fills the arena's bounds and the adit's part under the pad with stone; above it this hall's first part clears the lot.

entry.why: street is the causeway's last cell (data/placements.json streets causeway, [6088,4995] to [6152,4995], ground y106 by tools/ground.py, rounded: feet y107). entry.floor is the Core Gallery's first floor cell at the foot of the broad stair: 19.3 from Blaine's stand, farther than rctmod's forceBattleMaxDistance + 1 = 17, so the player stands in the gallery before he can call the fight.

exit.why: an iron door in the east wall at the broad stair's head, opened by the stone button on the wall inside it; out onto the lot's east side and round to the causeway. Nothing outside opens it, so it cannot be used to reach Blaine past the house and its juniors. Or back the way you came: every step of the house is walked both ways, and no drop on it is over three.
